_comment: File-driven scenario configuration (spec s.6: 'Connections and delay
patterns may be random or file-driven'; s.6 also requires the simulator
to support a configurable number of nodes, at least 8).
Values in 'default' apply to every scenario; a scenario's own block
overrides them. Editing this file changes a run without touching code.
num_nodes      : validator count, n = 3f+1 so f = (n-1)//3
bounded_delay  : delivery delay in virtual seconds once stabilized
drop_rate      : probability a message is dropped pre-stabilization
duplicate_rate : probability a message is duplicated
rate_limit     : max messages per sender per rate_window (0 = disabled)
num_byzantine  : equivocating validators (T7 only, must be <= f)
num_tamper     : validators given a mismatched node id (T3 only)
